gen-gf-special-gothic-expanded-one-fs-li: Pins in a wide board: Special Gothic Expanded One stands rigid, while Literata draws sturdy thin lines against slightly heavier ones. Down a full page, its open curves keep the reading bookish and unhurried.
gen-gf-spectral-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish authority, tempered: Spectral keeps its c from closing into an o, with crossbars slightly thinner than the stems. Bespoke Sans gives generous space between curve ends and stems, so long reading stays sharp and refined.
gen-gf-spectral-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Literary and bookish, Spectral SC opens its curves outward and swells measuredly from hairline to stem. Bespoke Sans adds low-contrast clarity and gives the swelling serif room to lead.
gen-gf-spinnaker-fs-literata: A wide-mouthed lowercase a gives Spinnaker its open, modern face, with low contrast running through the lines. And Literata brings hairlines that are present but never razor thin, adding a bookish note.
gen-gf-sree-krushnadevaraya-fs-bespoke-s: Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined, with generous space around its curves. Up top, Sree Krushnadevaraya stacks its letters closely, hairline strokes sitting beside swollen, brush-pressed stems with an editorial pull.
gen-gf-stix-two-text-fs-bespoke-sans: Stencil-cut and dignified, STIX Two Text takes large entrances into its letters. Bespoke Sans leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, giving the subtle pen-like bowls of the heading a sharp, low-contrast partner.
gen-gf-stoke-fs-bespoke-sans: Spacious and soft, Stoke leaves plenty of blank room between characters and keeps every curve mellow. Bespoke Sans is the sharp counterpart, and that crisp low contrast against the heading's softness is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-gf-sumana-fs-bespoke-sans: Refined and authoritative, Sumana steers a middle path between monoline strokes and razor-thin hairlines across the alphabet. Restraint is the draw, with Bespoke Sans keeping its low contrast sharp.
gen-gf-sura-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish and editorial, Sura sweeps its curves without ever closing them up, shifting weight modestly within each stroke. Bespoke Sans simply does crisp, low-contrast clarity best, leaving the sweep to Sura.
gen-gf-suranna-fs-bespoke-sans: Suranna lets its characters jostle like logs in a river boom, with heavy round shoulders ending in a faint hairline taper. Bespoke Sans stays sharp and low in contrast, with generous space between curve ends and stems.
